intended_object: A 2×2 matrix whose j-th column is the normalized column vector (`PulseCovariance.normalizedColumn`) of the j-th of two pulses. It is a helper inside the library's own Navier–Stokes covariance-bound argument; the docstring, the name and how the file uses it all point that way.
explanation: This definition packages the normalized columns of two `Pulse` objects into a `Mat2`, setting entry (i, j) to `normalizedColumn (P j).ψ (P j).x (P j).t i`. It matches its docstring. It exists only for the base-phase geometry argument in `BasePhaseGeometry.lean`. There it is decomposed into columns with `FlatCovariance.columns`, its entries are bounded against a reference matrix `H0`, and it is fed into a margin lemma and a column-scale-bounds lemma. The notion is specific to this proof and does not correspond to any standard mathematical object in the literature, so it is an auxiliary construction rather than a formalization of a mathematical notion.
